_comment: Word list used by moderation.service.js to flag outgoing agent messages — no AI/API involved, so this list is the ONLY thing controlling what gets caught. Edit freely: add/remove words, redeploy, done. 'severe' = clear profanity/insults/threats, plus rude 1st/2nd-person pronouns (มึง/กู/etc) toward a customer — unacceptable in a sales/service role even without another swear word attached. 'minor' = dismissive/unprofessional tone that falls short of that. Matching is substring-based against the message with spaces/punctuation stripped and lowercased (Thai has no spaces between words, so there's no real 'whole word' boundary to check) — entries here should also be written with no spaces. Known trade-off: 'กู' as a rude pronoun will also match inside unrelated words that happen to start with the same letters, e.g. 'กู้เงิน' (borrow money) or 'กู้คืน' (restore) — flagged messages are for a human admin to review, not auto-punish, so an occasional harmless match here is an acceptable cost for not missing real cases.
